bootstrap_unit: dataset + instance_id (cluster), model rows and categories kept together

metrics.gwet_ac1: (po-pe)/(1-pe), pe = 2*pi1*(1-pi1), pi1 = mean positive proportion; robust to prevalence

note: Chance-corrected kappa is unreliable under class skew (prevalence paradox); Gwet AC1 is the recommended coefficient here. Missing labels are never treated as 0.
